detail: Conservative ranking engine. Pure Go. No LLM in selection.
notes: Affiliate package is never imported.

detail: Public issuer-snapshot catalog cards as next applications, not wallet-use picks and not S01–S09 playbook assignment.
notes: Strategy code is attached after ranking via strategy.SelectFromQuestionnaire.

detail: POST /v1/recommendations. Bootstrap also re-evaluates the current wallet.
notes: Client-supplied existing_card_ids are discarded and rebuilt from the active wallet.

detail: Active wallet rows become ExistingCardIDs and OwnedCards.
notes: Only status=active. Client cannot inject owned IDs.

detail: Active public issuer_snapshot cards only.
formula_or_value: owner_user_id IS NULL AND data_kind='issuer_snapshot' AND is_active
notes: Custom/user-owned cards and demo rows never enter ranking.

detail: Skip and record a reason; do not score them.
notes: Exclusions sorted by slug.

detail: Wallet-with-card minus wallet-without-card minus the new card fee.
formula_or_value: ongoing = Gross(spend, owned+card) - Gross(spend, owned) - annual_fee_cents
notes: Welcome bonuses and credits are not added.

detail: If ongoing <= 0, exclude as no modeled improvement.
notes: A lower-rate card than the current wallet is rejected even with $0 fee.

detail: Start from dollars of incremental value, then add goal/travel bonuses.
formula_or_value: score = ongoing_cents/100 + 20 if goal match + 10 if travel match
notes: Score is ranking-only. It is not the Home wallet score (22–95).

detail: Higher score first; slug A–Z on ties; ranks 1..N.
formula_or_value: sort by score desc, card_slug asc
notes: Stable sort. Deterministic.

detail: Integer cents per month per category.
formula_or_value: allowed: rent, housing, food, dining, groceries, travel, everyday, other, gas, flights, hotels, streaming, entertainment, transit, drugstores
notes: Amounts 0 to 100000000 cents.

detail: Maximum annual fee the member will consider.
notes: Compared to card.AnnualFeeCents.

detail: Self-reported credit band.
notes: Card excluded if member rank < card.MinimumCreditTier rank.

detail: none, domestic, international, both.
notes: none matches none or both. Otherwise offered must equal wanted or both.

detail: cash_back, travel, or hybrid.
notes: hybrid matches any rewards type.

detail: Used only for student-slug gating.
notes: Empty life_stage blocks student cards.

detail: Rebuilt from wallet; used for already-owned exclusion and incremental Gross.
notes: OwnedCards JSON is not accepted from the client.

detail: Validated on the request; not used inside Recommend().
notes: Playbook/onboarding consume some of these elsewhere.

detail: Slug contains "student" and life_stage is not student.
formula_or_value: student eligibility has not been confirmed
notes: Checked first.

detail: Catalog ID or slug is in ExistingCardIDs.
AnnualFeeCents > FeeToleranceCents.
Member tier rank < card minimum.
formula_or_value: selected credit tier is below the catalog minimum
notes: Changing minimum_credit_tier is a product decision.

detail: Both sides not none, and travelMatches is false.
notes: none vs none/both is allowed.

detail: Incremental value after fee is <= 0.
formula_or_value: no positive modeled improvement over the current wallet
notes: Applied after other gates.

detail: 1 cent per point / percent as dollars.
notes: rate 2 means 2%.

detail: rent and housing always earn 0 in this model.
notes: Bilt-style housing rewards are intentionally excluded.

detail: Unknown dining/grocery split uses the lower of the two rates.
notes: Test: 4% dining + 3% groceries => 3% on food.

detail: Falls back to the card other rate, floored at 0.
notes: everyday uses other unless an everyday rate exists.

detail: For each spend category, take the best rate across the card set, then sum annual cents.
notes: Categories processed in sorted key order for determinism.

detail: Improvement vs current wallet, then subtract only the new card fee.
notes: Existing wallet fees are not re-subtracted because they cancel out of the delta.

detail: Highest annual cents from this card’s own rate * that category spend. Does not change rank.
notes: Uses the candidate’s rate, not the wallet-best delta.

detail: Welcome bonuses, statement credits, portal multipliers, capped-category uplift, housing, conditional rewards.
notes: Catalog FirstYearBonusCents is ignored.

detail: Incremental annual dollars.
notes: Example: 2500 cents => 25.00

detail: +20 if rewards_goal matches card.rewards_type, or either side is hybrid.
notes: cash_back vs travel does not match.

detail: +10 if travel scopes match and wanted is not none.
notes: none does not get this bonus even if the card is both/none.

detail: Score rounded to 2 decimal places.
Home 22–95 optimization score is scoring.Score, a different engine.
notes: Do not mix the two.

detail: Home ongoing value is valuation.Ongoing with reviewed credits; ranking uses valuation.Gross/Net only.
notes: Credits do not reorder applications.

detail: Ranked eligible cards with score, ongoing/first-year cents, reasons.
Skipped cards with machine/human reason strings.
notes: Sorted by slug.

detail: Engine constant plus max catalog dataset_version seen.
Input catalog plus owned cards copied onto the result.
notes: For audit of the run.

detail: Assigned after Recommend() from the questionnaire, not from ranking.
notes: Playbook names are separate from this ranked list.

detail: Community card text never changes ranking.
Compensation cannot affect ranking by construction.
Home “use this card now” is purchaseguide, wallet-only.
notes: Highest category rate among owned cards, not this engine.

detail: Assigned from questionnaire bands; ranking may still append one catalog card as next.
notes: A ranked outside-template card is not a picker accident.

detail: Monthly other $1000, wallet 2%, candidate 3% and $95 fee.
notes: 1.5% card is excluded as no improvement.

detail: Monthly food $100 + everyday $100; dining 4 / groceries 3 / other 2.
notes: everyday uses other=2.

detail: Dining $500 + other $200 / month; dining card 4% dining 1% other $95 fee vs 2% flat $0.
formula_or_value: Dining incremental wins and ranks 1; bonus cents ignored
notes: Goal travel +20 and travel scope both +10 apply to dining card.
